stopping_rule: Run this one upgraded feature configuration, select kernel hyperparameters by 5-fold CV grouped by source image, score once, and stop regardless of outcome.

hyperparams.features: k-means patch dictionaries (p=6,k=800,stride=1,pool=4x4 and p=4,k=400,stride=2,pool=3x3; ZCA whitening, triangle encoding) + HOG cell8 + HOG cell16, each block L2-normalized
hyperparams.augmentation: horizontal flip, +-4 px shifts, zoom 1.2 and 1.4 (14 variants per training image), flip test-time averaging
